caveats: These goals are derived benchmarks, not a reconciled operating plan. The solver's schedule creates more pipeline than the targets need, because pipeline created to fund one quarter also lands in later ones, so its own bookings are shown beside the targets; target-equivalent wins come from the target, not from the schedule. Ownership, segment and quota have no history in the files, so today's values stand in for the plan start.

The win-rate column is a dated benchmark, not a multiplier for the same period's created deals: it is the rate of the creation cohort old enough to have had its whole year, measured at the period's end (or the as-of date).

Segment forecasts share one pooled model out; no model is fitted to a slice, so the company back-test's credibility does not transfer to a segment. A behind cell is a planning discrepancy, not proof of a cause.
